sections.A: TBI bahar ki chot (girna, accident, maar, khel) se dimagh ka nuqsan hai. Shiddat GCS se napi jati hai; concussion halki TBI hai.
sections.B: Shadeed TBI: hosh kam, dono taraf kamzori, spasticity aur rawaiye ki tabdeeli. Concussion: sar dard, chakkar, dhyan aur neend ke masle.
sections.C: Chot kaise lagi, behoshi kitni der, chot ke baad yaad-dasht ka gap, aur abhi ke symptoms.
sections.D: Shadeed TBI mein GCS, pupils, ICU ki limits aur saans. Concussion mein symptoms, balance aur aankhon ki movement.
sections.G: GCS girna, nayi confusion, pupils barabar na hona, ya barhta sar dard aur ulti: emergency.
sections.H: Shadeed TBI: ICU limits ke andar positioning, seene ki care aur jaldi baithna. Concussion: aaraam ke baad dheere dheere activity.
sections.I: Shadeed TBI mein positioning, splints, tilt table aur jaldi khada hona. Concussion mein qadam ba qadam exercise aur school ya kaam par wapsi.
sections.K: Contracture ke liye splints aur serial casting; kuch patients mein FES.
sections.M: GCS ya Rancho level, mobility, symptom scales, exercise ki bardasht aur school ya kaam par wapsi.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. GCS 8 ya kam shadeed TBI hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
